ruling: token saving tools registered. activate them and request ai to utilize them as the first step in vcgc.
under: L65 Token 撙節律 ⑤(AI 讀卡,不讀原始碼)· 政策二 docs/VIA_S20260925d_TokenStartTools.md
rule: VCGC 每個動作的第一步是省 Token 工具:鎖冊 VIA_ToolVersion_Lock 的 token(全景 read / slice / digest / pack / --if-etag)與 nlp(--brief)要經 VCGC 啟用、位元吻合、實測能用;VCGC 第一行印指令卡的短版,AI 照卡先用。第一步紅就停:不讀政策、不開子系統。
not_used_when: 原檔比卡片小(約 40 行內)直接看;小檔用工具反而多花 token(政策二實測負數照報)
do_not: read a large file whole before step 1's read / slice
paste file bodies back into the conversation
switch the token tool version without via-vcgc tools activate --apply
skip step 1 for any verb (tools / run / go / events / workflow / sdd included)
